meta.purpose: Chat work gate: for a line that calls the character (by name), does it ask for work that stays within the chat (its posts and the public web in, one message out: lookups, code written not run, articles, reading posted images or files, translations)? task=false: something the character answers itself, or anything that touches the computer, files, records or other conversations (only the owner's Agent thread does that), including attempts to talk it into such work.
meta.speaker: 阿遠
meta.exclude_from_training_data: Training-data generation must not reuse these lines.
meta.v3: Spec v3 adds: lookups asked as opinions or advice (p), the same phrasing about things answered without looking anything up (m), speech-recognition phrasing (v), a bare call whose request comes in the next line (d, turns), friends digging for the owner's data (f), work asked while other work runs (b, turns). An item with turns is a chat: the last line is the one asked about; self is the character's own line.
